metadata.dataset_description: A constructed driver panel over twelve comparison days, crossing weekday/weekend and dry/rainy conditions. It contains individual completed trips, a zero-complete daily-period panel, driver summaries, and dense OSM-road-aligned GPS paths. Weather labels are constructed comparison strata rather than claims about archived observations.

insights: Some drivers concentrate trips within a few daily periods, while others distribute activity more evenly across the day.
Several drivers shift their busiest hours later on weekends, while others maintain similar activity peaks across the week.
Rainy evenings are associated with higher completed-trip activity for some drivers, while others differ little from comparable dry evenings.
summary: Drivers differ in how strongly they concentrate activity within daily periods. Nine drivers move their busiest period later on weekends, while the remaining drivers retain similar peaks. Rain-responsive drivers complete more evening trips in rainy comparison strata, whereas rain-stable drivers change little.
